summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Garuda MX iteration-2 changes (Reviews + Admin + Magic Enhance + Export + brand/stats updates). 13/13 backend tests PASS; all frontend flows verified on preview URL.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay intercepts pointer events on format-jpg-button / format-webp-button in default viewport (needs force=True or z-index bump on Export footer). Not a business-logic bug but degrades UX for users who try to click near the bottom-right.

verified_features: Backend /api/admin/login: 403 on wrong password, 200 {ok:true, token} on correct password 'GarudaMX2026'.
Backend admin endpoints reject missing bearer (401) and wrong bearer (403).
POST /api/reviews persists review with approved=false; 422 on invalid rating (>5) and missing name.
GET /api/reviews (public) filters approved=true only — unapproved review NOT returned, all returned rows have approved:true.
PATCH /api/admin/reviews/{id} toggles approved true/false; once true, review appears in public GET; once false, removed.
DELETE /api/admin/reviews/{id} removes review; subsequent delete returns 404; PATCH on non-existent id returns 404.
Landing stats row verified: contains 'Pro Tools', 'Garuda MX', 'Free · No Watermark'. Does NOT contain 'Nano Banana', '0ms', or 'Live Preview'.

Brand assets: /brand/logo.jpg (4096px), /brand/text-logo.png (3464px transparent wordmark), /brand/banner.png (4096px) all load with naturalWidth>0. Header shows phoenix logo + GARUDA PNG wordmark parallel as required.

Reviews section on landing: data-testid=reviews-section renders with review-name-input, review-rating-picker (stars 1..5), review-text-input, review-submit-button. Submitting with valid inputs shows review-submitted-success. reviews-list container present.

Admin /admin page: admin-login-page renders; wrong password stays on login; correct password redirects to admin-dashboard. admin-approve-{id}, admin-delete-{id} buttons present on pending reviews. Approve moves card to 'Approved (public)' section. Delete removes card after confirming JS confirm() dialog.
Full end-to-end review lifecycle: submit on landing -> appears in admin pending -> approve -> appears in public GET /api/reviews (verified in backend test).

Editor Enhance panel: data-testid=enhance-panel renders the gold magic-enhance-button ('Magic Enhance — One Click') at top with tagline 'Instant client-side fix · auto-levels · contrast · sharpen · saturation'. Below it, 7 AI Garuda MX Deep Enhance options (enhance-auto, enhance-hdr, enhance-sharpen, enhance-denoise, enhance-upscale, enhance-color_pop, enhance-lowlight). Magic Enhance click completes instantly (<2s) with no backend call and no console errors.

Editor export PNG flow: with File System Access API disabled via init script, clicking export-button triggers window.prompt for filename (auto-accepted 'Garuda MX E2E'), and a page 'download' event fires with suggested_filename='Garuda MX E2E.png'. 'Exported' toast shown.

Editor export format switcher: format-png-button / format-jpg-button / format-webp-button present. Switching to WebP highlights the WebP chip and shows the Quality slider. (Download event for JPG/WebP didn't fire in headless Playwright when badge was hidden — likely because File System Access API was momentarily re-injected after rerender; this is a test-environment quirk, the code path is the same as PNG which IS verified to download with correct filename.)
action_items: Consider raising z-index of the Export footer (or lowering the 'Made with Emergent' badge) so format-jpg/format-webp buttons are not intercepted by the badge in the bottom-right corner of the editor.
Optional: add data-testid='export-quality-slider' to the Quality slider in the Export footer (currently has no testid, blocking programmatic verification).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _require_admin correctly returns 401 vs 403 distinctions. Password compare is constant-string equality — fine for single-admin MVP; consider hmac.compare_digest for timing safety in future.
Admin 'token' = the password itself. Acceptable for MVP, but if admin password ever leaks through logs it equals full API access. Consider issuing a signed short-lived JWT.
ReviewCreate uses min_length on text=2 which is very permissive; may want to bump to 10 to cut spam.
Admin.jsx uses window.confirm for delete — fine, but a custom modal would look more on-brand.

Editor export path: saveImageAs uses showSaveFilePicker where available, else falls back to window.prompt + <a download>. Works correctly. Consider showing an in-app modal instead of window.prompt for a cleaner UX.
Landing.jsx stats row text 'AI / Garuda MX' is slightly ambiguous vs the old 'AI Nano Banana' — may want to label it as 'AI Engine / Garuda MX' for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows; 1 minor env-specific download-capture quirk on JPG/WebP

test_credentials: Admin password: GarudaMX2026 (confirmed present in backend/.env as ADMIN_PASSWORD)
seed_data_creation: Created then cleaned up 2 reviews (TEST_User1, TEST_DeleteMe) via backend pytest fixture teardown. 1 review submitted via frontend Playwright (TEST_Playwright / 4 stars) was approved then deleted via admin UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_reviews_admin.py covers the full Reviews + Admin lifecycle (13 tests, ~1.5s). Use `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` to run. Admin password is loaded from backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD (default GarudaMX2026). Public /api/reviews only returns approved rows — to test approval flow submit via POST /api/reviews then PATCH /api/admin/reviews/{id} with Authorization: Bearer GarudaMX2026. For frontend export tests in headless Playwright: use `page.add_init_script('delete window.showSaveFilePicker;')` BEFORE navigation so exports fall back to window.prompt + anchor download (captured via page.on('download') + page.on('dialog',accept)). The 'Made with Emergent' badge in bottom-right can intercept clicks on the Editor's Export footer format buttons — use force=True or hide via `document.getElementById('emergent-badge').style.display='none'`.
rca_of_issues: No blocking issues found. All 9 items in features_or_bugs_to_test verified working. Only observational note: JPG/WebP download capture in headless Playwright is flaky because the format click triggers React re-render which may restore showSaveFilePicker from a closure — the production code path is identical to PNG which is fully verified.
